title: 向管理层汇报增长，怎样把数据连到下一步？
topic: 投资者日：增长指标与资源选择

source.title: Spotify’s 2026 Investor Day Recap: Raising Ambition for the Next Era of Media
source.section: Spotify’s 2026 Investor Day Recap: Raising Ambition for the Next Era of Media

paragraphs: The company reported that active advertisers were up 68% year over year in the first quarter. Looking ahead, it is focused on growing the market for Spotify advertising, using AI to make the platform work harder, and building new ad experiences that feel more native to Spotify.

Early product deployments are driving measurable engagement gains, including 9% growth in Autoplay song saves, 9% improvement in podcast discovery from Home, and nearly 20% more interaction with DJ messages.

Spotify’s CFO described a financial model focused on growing users and subscribers, expanding gross margin, controlling costs, and investing where the company sees clear returns. The company’s 2030 targets include mid-teens revenue growth and an operating margin above 20%.
translations: 公司报告称，第一季度活跃广告主数量同比增长了 68%。接下来，公司希望扩大 Spotify 广告市场，借助 AI 提升平台效能，并开发更符合 Spotify 使用体验的广告形式。
早期上线的产品带来了可衡量的互动增长：自动播放歌曲的收藏量增长 9%，用户通过首页发现播客的次数增加 9%，与 DJ 消息的互动增加近 20%。
Spotify 首席财务官介绍了公司的财务模型：增长用户和订阅用户、提高毛利率、控制成本，并把资金投向回报清晰的领域。公司设定的 2030 年目标包括营收年增长达到十几个百分点（约 15%），营业利润率超过 20%。
fullTextParagraphs: Spotify’s 2026 Investor Day offered the financial community a deeper look at the company’s business, product strategy, and long-term vision. The event mapped out the next evolution: a service moving from curation and recommendation into an era of generation.
The company highlighted its scale across 184 markets and 761 million active users. It now has nearly 300 million subscribers, making Spotify one of the largest subscription businesses in the world.

Product leaders explained how making time on Spotify valuable shapes what the company builds and how it grows. They pointed to Wrapped, the annual personalized recap, which generated more than 620 million shares in 2025.

Spotify’s Global Head of Ad Product explained how the company rebuilt its advertising business around the Spotify experience. Its unified system gives advertisers more ways to connect with audiences across music, podcasts, and video.

The company reported that active advertisers were up 68% year over year in the first quarter. Looking ahead, it is focused on growing the market for Spotify advertising, using AI to make the platform work harder, and building new ad experiences that feel more native to Spotify.

Early product deployments are driving measurable engagement gains, including 9% growth in Autoplay song saves, 9% improvement in podcast discovery from Home, and nearly 20% more interaction with DJ messages.

Spotify’s CFO described a financial model focused on growing users and subscribers, expanding gross margin, controlling costs, and investing where the company sees clear returns. The company’s 2030 targets include mid-teens revenue growth and an operating margin above 20%.

notes.explain: Looking ahead 后面接未来重点或计划。
notes.example: Looking ahead, we’ll expand the pilot only after reviewing the cost.

notes.explain: measurable 表示结果能用指标观察。
notes.example: The redesign delivered measurable engagement gains.

notes.phrase: investing where the company sees clear returns
notes.meaning: 把资金投向回报清晰的领域
notes.explain: where 引出投资的领域或条件。
notes.example: We’re investing where the pilot shows clear returns.

scenario.title: 练习情境：功能试点有增长，也增加了客服成本
english: A new feature increased weekly engagement by 9% in a four-week pilot.
The rollout also increased support costs, and the team has not tested all customer groups.
Report the result, explain the trade-off, and recommend the next investment decision.
chinese: 假设一项新功能在为期四周的试点中，让每周互动率提升了 9%。
上线后客服成本也增加了，而且团队还没有测试所有客户群体。
请汇报结果和取舍，并建议下一步是否继续投入。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请用英语向管理层汇报这次功能试点：说明 9% 的互动增长、客服成本上升和还未覆盖所有客户群体，并提出下一步建议。
firstAttempt.sample: In the four-week pilot, the new feature increased weekly engagement by 9%, but support costs also rose. We haven’t tested it with all customer groups yet. I recommend extending the test to a broader group and tracking both engagement and support costs before a wider rollout.
firstAttempt.rationale: 同时报告增长和成本，再用下一轮测试补齐尚未验证的客户群体。

taskPhrases.example: Early product deployments increased Autoplay song saves by 9%.
taskPhrases.translation: 早期上线的产品使自动播放歌曲收藏量增长了 9%。

taskPhrases.collocation: connect results to the next action
taskPhrases.example: Looking ahead, we’ll test the feature with another customer group.
taskPhrases.translation: 接下来，我们会在另一组客户中测试这项功能。

taskPhrases.meaning: 我们会把资源投向……的领域
taskPhrases.example: We’ll invest where customer growth justifies the additional cost.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们会把资源投向客户增长足以覆盖额外成本的领域。

words.example: The new feature increased customer engagement.
words.translation: 新功能提高了客户互动。
words.note: 可用具体行为指标衡量，例如点击、收藏或回复。

words.example: The platform added several active advertisers this quarter.
words.translation: 平台本季度新增了几家活跃广告主。
words.note: 指在媒体或平台上投放广告的企业或个人。

words.example: The company raised its operating margin target.
words.translation: 公司提高了营业利润率目标。
words.note: 用于说明营业利润占营收的比例。

structure.original: Looking ahead, it is focused on growing the market for Spotify advertising, using AI to make the platform work harder, and building new ad experiences that feel more native to Spotify.
analysis: Looking ahead 用来引出下一阶段的重点。
三个动名词短语并列，列出增长市场、提升平台效能和开发新体验。
structure.transfer: Looking ahead, we’ll improve onboarding, expand customer support, and test a lower-cost plan.

rewrite.bad: The feature is a success, so we should invest more.
rewrite.good: In the four-week pilot, the new feature increased weekly engagement by 9%, but support costs also rose. We haven’t tested it with all customer groups yet. Before investing in a wider rollout, we should extend the test and track both engagement and support costs.
rewrite.translation: 在为期四周的试点中，新功能使每周互动率提升了 9%，但客服成本也有所上升。我们还没有测试所有客户群体。扩大投入前，我们应延长测试，并同时跟踪互动率和客服成本。
rewrite.pattern: The pilot increased [benefit], but [cost] also rose. Before expanding, we should test [remaining group] and track both [benefit] and [cost].

cloze.prompt: Early product deployments increased Autoplay song saves ______ 9%.
cloze.why: increase by + 数值 表示提升了多少。

cloze.prompt: Looking ahead, we’ll ______ the feature with another group.
cloze.why: test with another group 指扩大前再做一轮测试。

cloze.prompt: We’ll invest where the pilot shows clear ______.
cloze.why: returns 指投入带来的回报。

dictation.text: Early product deployments are driving measurable engagement gains.
dictation.why: 听出 deployments 与 measurable gains，抓住产品上线和互动指标的关系。

dictation.text: We’ll invest where the pilot shows clear returns.
dictation.why: 听清 where 后面的投入判断条件。

translationPractice.prompt: 早期上线的产品使自动播放歌曲收藏量增长了 9%。
translationPractice.answer: Early product deployments increased Autoplay song saves by 9%.
translationPractice.why: 用 increased…by… 准确报告来源中的指标变化。

translationPractice.prompt: 接下来，我们会在另一组客户中测试这项功能。
translationPractice.answer: Looking ahead, we’ll test the feature with another customer group.
translationPractice.why: 把已观察到的结果连接到下一步测试。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们会把资源投向客户增长足以覆盖额外成本的领域。
translationPractice.answer: We’ll invest where customer growth justifies the additional cost.
translationPractice.why: 说明哪些回报会成为投入资源的依据。

choice.prompt: 试点带来互动增长，但客服量也明显上升。管理层问是否立即全面推出，较好的回答是？
options: The engagement number went up, so we should launch everywhere.
The pilot increased engagement, but support costs also rose. Let’s test with another group and compare both outcomes before expanding.
We should cancel the feature because it costs more.
choice.why: 同时报告收益与成本，再补充验证后决定是否扩大。

output.prompt: 一项付费提醒功能提升了点击率，但退订量也上升。请汇报结果并提出下一轮验证。
output.sample: The reminder increased click-through by 7%, but unsubscribes also rose. Looking ahead, we’ll test a less frequent schedule with another customer group and track clicks, unsubscribes, and purchases before expanding.
check: 报告一个结果和一个代价
列出决定是否扩大的指标

blockers: 人工听审音频，确认语速、停顿与截断。
真实账号进度保存与恢复、生产环境逐期核验。
